meta.title: LANDING INSURANCE BROKERS

sections.title: Software development for insurance brokers
sections.subtitle: We develop custom software solutions to help you simplify processes, connect platforms, and respond to the real needs of your business.
sections.buttonText: Learn how we can help you

sections.title: Do you identify with any of these challenges?

services.title: How many platforms do you need to open to quote a policy?
services.description: Between insurers, multi-quoters, CRM and other tools, a single quote may require checking different systems and moving information from one to another. This makes the process slower and increases manual work.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
services.answer: Today it is possible to integrate multi-quoters, insurer portals and other platforms to streamline the quoting process.

services.title: Do renewals still depend on manual follow-up?
services.description: When tracking expirations, reminders and follow-ups depends on spreadsheets or manual tasks, keeping pace as your portfolio grows becomes increasingly complex.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
services.answer: Automatic alerts, CRMs and follow-up workflows help maintain better control over renewals.

services.title: Is tracking a claim still a manual process?
services.description: Calls, emails and consultations between the client and the insurer make it difficult to know the status of each case and provide timely responses.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
services.answer: Integrating claims tracking makes traceability easier and allows you to respond more quickly to clients.

services.title: Is your customer information distributed across different platforms?
services.description: Commercial, administrative and insurer data is often spread across different systems. This makes it difficult to have a complete view of each client and make decisions with up-to-date information.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
services.answer: Centralizing customer information facilitates commercial follow-up and faster decision-making.

sections.title: What can we develop for your business?
sections.description: Each insurance broker faces different challenges. That's why we develop custom technology solutions that adapt to the way your business operates.

services.title: Does your appointment scheduling still depend on WhatsApp, Excel or a notebook?
services.description: When appointments are managed from different channels, maintaining control over the schedule takes more time and increases administrative workload.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
list: More time spent on administrative tasks
Risk of duplicate appointments or cancellations without follow-up
services.answer: Scheduling solutions, automation and conversational assistants can centralize this process, reduce manual tasks and improve the patient experience.

services.title: Does documenting each consultation take more time than expected?
services.description: Recording the medical history manually reduces the time available for care and increases administrative workload.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
list: More time dedicated to clinical records
services.answer: Today it is possible to incorporate solutions with artificial intelligence such as clinical assistants, voice dictation, document automation, clinical information extraction and support during the consultation to facilitate the work of healthcare staff.

services.title: Is patient information distributed across different systems?
services.description: When the clinical history, laboratory, diagnostic images, schedule and billing work separately, consulting information becomes slower and data duplication increases.

services.title: Are there still administrative processes that could be automated?
services.description: Document management, authorizations, patient follow-up and sending results are still carried out manually in many clinics and IPS.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
list: Less capacity to see more patients
services.answer: Automating these processes helps reduce repetitive tasks, optimize times and facilitate the daily work of staff.

sections.title: Software development for stores and points of sale
sections.subtitle: We develop custom software solutions to help you optimize processes, integrate information and improve your business management.
sections.buttonText: Learn how we can help you

sections.title: Do you identify with any of these challenges?

services.title: Does your point of sale screen slow down the payment process?
services.description: Many cash register systems retain screens with too many options and processes designed for keyboard and mouse, slowing down the daily work of staff.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
services.answer: Today it is possible to develop POS systems with touch interfaces, quick access and screens adapted to each role to speed up each transaction.

services.title: Does your system still depend on local servers?
services.description: Many businesses continue to operate on local infrastructure, limiting access to information and making it difficult to operate from different locations or devices.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
services.answer: Cloud solutions allow access to the system from anywhere and adapt to centralized or hybrid operation models when the business requires it.

services.title: Do your reports show data, but not the information you need to make decisions?
services.description: Many systems continue to generate reports focused on accounting, leaving little visibility into the commercial behavior of the business.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
list: Slow reaction to changes in the business
services.answer: Dashboards, real-time analytics and visual indicators allow you to make decisions faster and monitor sales, inventory and business performance.

services.title: Is creating new products still a complex process?
services.description: In many systems it is necessary to fill in numerous fields before being able to register a product and put it up for sale, slowing down the process.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
list: Less agility to respond to the market
services.answer: Today it is possible to automate product creation through bulk loads, intelligent parametrization and artificial intelligence, reducing times and facilitating catalog management.

services.title: Do you pay for features you don't really use?
services.description: Many businesses acquire solutions with modules they don't need, increasing costs and system complexity.
services.question: How does this impact your business?
services.answer: Modular solutions allow you to incorporate only the features the business needs and expand capabilities as new requirements arise.
